POISON.description: Loses 1 + 8% of max HP at the start of each of its turns.

BURN.description: Takes 5 Fire damage at the start of each turn. Stacks.

REGEN.description: Recovers 6 + WIS/3 HP at the start of each of its turns.

MARKED.description: Pressure point exposed. Finishing Strike hits twice.

SUNDERED.description: Guard broken. Heavy Blow hits twice.
